findings.highlight: past this one small sheet, is Saber’s room
findings.evidenceJa: 襖一枚隔てた向こうがセイバーの部屋
findings.governingReading: Saber’s room lies next door beyond a single fusuma panel.
findings.explanation: Small sheet fails to identify the sliding partition and makes the room layout sound physically absurd.

findings.highlight: Uhno, that’s not it.
findings.evidenceJa: あいや、そんな事はない
findings.governingReading: Shirou stammers a denial.
findings.explanation: The hesitation and no are fused into Uhno.

findings.highlight: Are you fine?
findings.evidenceJa: それを言うならセイバーの方こそいいのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou turns Saber’s concern back on her and asks whether her own condition is all right.
findings.explanation: The generic question loses the reciprocal contrast and bodily concern.

findings.highlight: I am still above my average.
findings.evidenceJa: このままでも平均値はクリアしています
findings.governingReading: Even unhealed, Saber clears the general average standard for a Servant.
findings.explanation: My average changes a comparative class benchmark into Saber’s personal historical average.

findings.highlight: It’s not a bluff. confidence or boasting.
findings.evidenceJa: そこに虚勢は感じられない
findings.governingReading: Shirou detects no bravado in Saber’s estimate.
findings.explanation: Variant debris leaves an ungrammatical “confidence or boasting” fragment after the completed sentence.

findings.highlight: II don’t want such a slender girl to fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 戦って欲しくはない
findings.governingReading: Shirou does not want the slight girl to fight.
findings.explanation: The pronoun is duplicated as II.

findings.highlight: Any other objectives are useless.
findings.evidenceJa: それ以外の目的など余分なだけだ
findings.governingReading: To Saber, purposes beyond fighting are extraneous to a summoned Servant.
findings.explanation: Useless is more contemptuous and absolute than superfluous to her role.

findings.highlight: how should I put thisSaber is lacking in humanity
findings.evidenceJa: なんていうかセイバーには人間味が欠けている
findings.governingReading: Shirou struggles to say that Saber lacks human warmth.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses this and Saber.

findings.highlight: I have to have her do something she enjoys.
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと自分の楽しみを持たないと嘘だと思う
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Saber ought to have joys of her own while she exists here.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou the agent who must make her perform an enjoyable activity, undercutting the autonomy he wants for her.

findings.highlight: I shouldn’t have been interested in Saber’s true identity
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はセイバーの正体になんて興味はなかった筈だし
findings.governingReading: Shirou thought he was not interested in Saber’s identity, but now recognizes that has changed.
findings.explanation: Shouldn’t have been makes the interest improper rather than contradicting his prior self-image.

findings.highlight: Huhyou can, but what?
findings.evidenceJa: えいいけど、なに
findings.governingReading: Shirou hesitantly permits Saber’s question.
findings.explanation: The reaction and pronoun are fused into Huhyou.

findings.highlight: You were cut by Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーに打ち倒されました
findings.governingReading: Berserker struck Shirou down when he tried to save Saber.
findings.explanation: Cut supplies a weapon action instead of the broader fact that he was violently felled.

findings.highlight: I feel that I must ask you to understand.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方という人間を知る為に訊いておくべき事
findings.governingReading: Saber must ask in order to understand Shirou as a person.
findings.explanation: The translation omits the object and purpose of understanding, weakening the scene’s explicit relational aim.

findings.highlight: I understood that I’d be killed if I approached.
findings.evidenceJa: 近寄れば絶対に殺されると理解していた
findings.governingReading: Shirou understood with certainty that approaching meant being killed.
findings.explanation: The explicit absolute certainty is dropped from the premise of his choice.

findings.highlight: I didn’t care about what would happen afterwards.
findings.evidenceJa: その後の事なんて知らない
findings.governingReading: In that instant, Shirou gave no thought to what would happen afterward.
findings.explanation: Didn’t care turns narrowed awareness and priority into emotional indifference toward his own fate.

findings.highlight: you automatically tried to save me?
findings.evidenceJa: ただ自然に、私を助けようとしたのですね
findings.governingReading: Saber concludes that Shirou tried to save her naturally, without calculation.
findings.explanation: Automatically mechanizes a moral impulse; Shirou’s reply then rejects the wrong concept.

findings.highlight: Soif someone like that exists
findings.evidenceJa: ですからそんな人間がいるとしたら
findings.governingReading: Saber continues her hypothetical warning.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses So and if.

findings.highlight: I deflect it with heartless words.
findings.evidenceJa: 心にもない言葉で、懸命にはね除けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou desperately fends off her warning with words he does not mean.
findings.explanation: Heartless falsely characterizes the content as cruel instead of marking the promise as insincere.

findings.highlight: If you do not make any mistakes, you will become a proper magus.
findings.evidenceJa: 道さえ間違えなければ、きっと正しい魔術師になれる
findings.governingReading: If Shirou does not take the wrong path, Saber believes he can become a proper magus.
findings.explanation: Any mistakes turns an ethical warning about direction into a demand for general errorlessness.

findings.highlight: Such wisdom is sometimes called as cowardice.
findings.evidenceJa: そういった賢明さを、時に臆病と言うのです
findings.governingReading: That kind of prudence is sometimes called cowardice.
findings.explanation: Called as is grammatically incorrect in this construction.

findings.highlight: She must be relieved.
findings.evidenceJa: 安心したのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively wonders whether Saber is relieved.
findings.explanation: Must promotes his uncertain reading into a confident inference.

findings.highlight: we end up staying in the room together a while
findings.evidenceJa: 味気ない部屋で時間を過ごす事になった
findings.governingReading: They pass some time together in the bare, flavorless room after he loses his words.
findings.explanation: The room’s emotional and physical barrenness disappears from the closing image.
